column8: Minidregg.Pred.PredList → ℕ → List ℕ → Option Minidregg.Pred.Pred
∀ (p : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.firstFailingLeaf p old new = Option.none ↔ Minidregg.Pred.eval p old new = Bool.true

∀ (p : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State) (path : List ℕ), Minidregg.Pred.firstFailingLeaf p old new = Option.some path → ∃ q, p.subterm path = Option.some q ∧ q.isLeaf = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval q old new = Bool.false
Minidregg.Pred.Oracle → Minidregg.Pred.Pred → Minidregg.Pred.State → Minidregg.Pred.State → Option (List ℕ)
Minidregg.Pred.Oracle → Minidregg.Pred.PredList → Minidregg.Pred.State → Minidregg.Pred.State → Option (List ℕ)

∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (ps : Minidregg.Pred.PredList) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.leafWithAll O ps old new = Option.none ↔ Minidregg.Pred.evalWithAll O ps old new = Bool.true

∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (ps : Minidregg.Pred.PredList) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State) (path : List ℕ), Minidregg.Pred.leafWithAll O ps old new = Option.some path → ∃ i rest q, path = i :: rest ∧ ps.subterm i rest = Option.some q ∧ q.isLeaf = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O q old new = Bool.false
∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (p : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.leafWith O p old new = Option.none ↔ Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O p old new = Bool.true

∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (p : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State) (path : List ℕ), Minidregg.Pred.leafWith O p old new = Option.some path → ∃ q, p.subterm path = Option.some q ∧ q.isLeaf = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O q old new = Bool.false
